thread:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — Greenline POC kickoff. They want an AI assistant to triage inbound support requests + KB search to deflect tickets. Need final prioritized list of endpoints, acceptance criteria, and a tight 6-week timeline. Also they asked about pricing for a reserved pool vs hosted.
Priya (SE): Quick take: prioritize 1) customer-facing chat (generate + context), 2) semantic KB search (embeddings + rerank), 3) intent classification + routing (lightweight).
Alex (Sales): +1. Customer cares most about deflection and TTR.
Jamal (PM): For acceptance metrics we should propose measurable KPIs: deflection >=20%, avg handle time drop >=30%, response accuracy for intents >=85%, hallucination rate <=2% on QA prompts. Latency SLO p95 <=600ms for chat.
Priya (SE): Technical KPIs to add: embedding recall@5 >=90% on their KB eval set, rerank MRR >=0.6, classification F1 >=0.8. Throughput target: 25 qps baseline, 50 qps peak. Token budget: estimate 1.2M tokens/day for pilot.
Maya (CS): Business owner wants ROI calc — show cost per resolved ticket and break-even at Xk monthly tickets.
Lina (Security): Need answers for: data residency, TLS + customer-managed KMS, SOC2, VPC peering, and whether PII can be redacted before leaving Greenline. Also request: audit logs retention 1y.
Priya (SE): We can offer Private (VPC) for residency + KMS. For hosted: at-rest encryption + SOC2. Redaction: suggest client-side redaction or an in-pipeline dynamic hash before send.
Alex (Sales): Pricing question: Greenline asked if reserved pool discount applies for a 12-month commit with 4 GPUs. Can we do a blended price for the pilot month?
Jamal (PM): For pilot proposal: 6-week plan:
- Week 0: infra prep, VPC peering + onboarding
- Week 1: integrate generate + KB endpoints, basic prompt templates
- Week 2: collect dev traffic, run eval harness on baseline prompts
- Week 3: prompt tuning + rerank params, run classification labels
- Week 4: load test to 50 qps, latency tuning, cost profiling
- Week 5: stakeholder demo + business metrics collection
- Week 6: decision + handoff (go/no-go)
Priya (SE): Example eval harness commands (very small snippet):
```
# run embeddings eval
python eval/embeddings_eval.py --dataset greenline_kb.jsonl --topk 5 --out results.json
# run generation QA checks
python eval/generation_eval.py --prompts prompts/greenline_seeds.json --metrics hallucination,exact_match
```
Priya (SE): Sample minimal integration curl for chat route (for their devs):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"How do I reset my password?"}],"max_tokens":256}'
```
Lina (Security): Also asking for a security questionnaire turnaround time — can we commit to 5 business days?
Alex (Sales): Yes, SE + Security will take it. I'll notify Greenline.
Maya (CS): Success criteria checklist for pilot (for execs):
- Integration complete and stable
- Deflection >=20% on pilot support queue
- Avg handle time reduced >=30% for routed tickets
- No P0 security findings
- Demo with live traffic within week 5
Priya (SE): Acceptance thresholds (final proposal):
- Chat p95 latency <=600ms
- Hallucination <=2% measured on published eval set
- Embedding recall@5 >=90%
- Classification F1 >=0.8
- Operational: error rate <0.5% and uptime >=99.5% during pilot
Alex (Sales): Can SE please draft the prompt set and eval seeds by Friday?
Priya (SE): I'll push a PR with prompt fixtures and evaluation script by EOD Thursday.
DevOps Bot: Ticket #POC-498 created for VPC peering kickoff (assignee: infra-team) :rocket:
Lina (Security): I'll scope the questionnaire; expecting a few follow-ups on KMS config and key rotation policy.
Jamal (PM): One blocker to flag: Greenline legal requires data processing addendum signed before ingest. Sales to handle.
Alex (Sales): I'll get the DPA signed. Anything else?
Maya (CS): Please include a short list of 10 production prompts for the exec demo that show deflection (self-serve KB answers).
Priya (SE): Will add 10 demo prompts to the PR.
Alex (Sales): Great — next sync Thurs 11am PT to review PR + pricing sheet. :thumbsup:
